name: Household Ledger - Price Refresh Agent (SCAFFOLD, not deployed)

parameters.content:
## SCAFFOLD — documentId/Sheets credential wired, price-source design resolved
Modeled on Beautiful Nature Scenes' Content Calendar Generator (gap-detection) and Tally Sorter (clear+append). Not yet live-tested.

SETUP TODOs before activating:
1. Connect a Google Sheets credential (documentId is already wired to the real spreadsheet).
2. Connect a Claude/Anthropic credential for the extraction step (replace `REPLACE_WITH_ANTHROPIC_CREDENTIAL_ID`).
3. Connect a Brave Search API credential for the search-fallback branch (replace `REPLACE_WITH_SEARCH_API_CREDENTIAL_ID`) — get a free/paid key at brave.com/search/api.
4. Optionally start filling in `Catalog.product_url` per item/store (new optional column) — rows with a URL take the more-reliable known-page branch; rows without one always fall back to search. Not required to activate; an empty Catalog full of blanks just means every item takes the search branch until you fill some in.

Open Decision #1 (household-ledger-architecture.md §8), resolved 2026-07-31: hybrid — known product-page URL when Catalog has one ('Has Product URL?' branch), general web search otherwise. Known-URL is materially more reliable (stable page vs. a search result that could be a reseller/wrong variant/stale cache); search fallback trades some accuracy for zero URL-maintenance burden on items you haven't gotten to yet. Costco's online prices are often member-login-gated either way — a scrape that comes back priceless there is expected, not a bug.

Two independent branches, both off the same weekly trigger:
BRANCH A (top): finds stale Catalog items, fetches a price source (known URL or search fallback), extracts via LLM, stages the result in PriceLog as 'pending' rather than trusting it immediately.
BRANCH B (bottom): promotes PriceLog entries that have sat as 'pending' for the configured hold period with no newer conflicting scrape — this is the 24-48h freshness gate from CLAUDE.md/architecture.md §5, implemented as a two-step stage-then-promote rather than a bare scrape-and-trust path.

Failure handling: an item that fails extraction validation is logged via a NoOp node for now (see its own note) rather than retried automatically — matches the existing Webhook Agent's 'acceptable for v1, revisit later' precedent, not a gap unique to this workflow.

nodes.name: Weekly Refresh Trigger
nodes.notes: Weekly by default — CLAUDE.md flags the n8n plan's monthly execution cap (~55 items x 2 stores adds up fast if scheduled too often). Adjust once real usage shows how often prices actually move.

nodes.name: Has Product URL?
nodes.notes: Open Decision #1, resolved 2026-07-31: hybrid — use a known product-page URL when Catalog has one, fall back to a general web search otherwise. Populate the optional Catalog.product_url column over time; items without one always take the search branch.

nodes.name: Fetch Known Product Page
nodes.notes: Known-URL branch — most reliable, since it hits a stable page rather than a search result. Costco product pages may not show member pricing without an authenticated session; a scrape returning a blank/missing price there is expected, not a bug, and Validate Extraction will correctly reject it.

nodes.name: Search Web for Price
nodes.notes: Search-fallback branch, used only when Catalog has no product_url for this item/store. Brave Search API chosen for its simple single-header-auth REST shape; swap providers here if preferred — nothing downstream depends on Brave specifically. Expect a materially higher extraction failure/mismatch rate than the known-URL branch (see Validate Extraction's notes). Confirmed live 2026-07-31: Brave's API 422s on n8n's default multi-type Accept header, hence the explicit Accept: application/json header above.

nodes.name: Extract Price via LLM
nodes.notes: Structured-JSON-only extraction per CLAUDE.md's 'never free text' rule. Same shape ME101 uses for its equivalent agent (~38.5% early failure rate there per the Master Work Log) — validation happens in the next node, not here. Reads $json.data generically since either upstream branch (known-URL fetch or search fallback) can feed this node. Confirmed live 2026-07-31: Anthropic's Messages API 400s without an anthropic-version header, which isn't part of the API-key credential itself — hence the explicit header above.

nodes.name: Stage in PriceLog as Pending
nodes.notes: Uses the proposed status/scraped_at schema extension — see Setup Notes. This is the 'stage' half of the 24-48h freshness gate; Catalog itself isn't touched here.

nodes.name: Log Extraction Failure (v1)
nodes.notes: v1: no persistent failure log, no retry — same 'acceptable for v1, revisit later' shape as the existing Webhook Agent's Delete Row node. A v2 could append to a failures sheet or alert via Telegram after N consecutive failures for the same item.

nodes.name: Mark PriceLog Entry Promoted
nodes.notes: Prevents this same entry being re-promoted on next week's run.
